mapper.select: SELECT ser.series_id, ser.category_id, category.category_name, ser.series_name, ser.series_image, ser.series_description, ser.is_spiritpower, ser.is_hot, ser.is_avoid, ser.is_popular_new, ser.is_hot_recommend, ser.price, ser.price_ranges, ser.created_by, ser.created_time, ser.updated_by, ser.updated_time FROM product_series as ser inner join product_category as category on category.category_id = ser.category_id where series_id = #{seriesId} ORDER BY series_id

select ser.series_id, ser.category_id, category.category_name, ser.series_name, ser.series_image, ser.series_description, ser.is_spiritpower, ser.is_hot, ser.is_avoid, ser.is_popular_new, ser.is_hot_recommend, ser.price, (select count(1) from blind_box_records bbr where bbr.series_id = ser.series_id) as purchaseCount, ser.price_ranges, ser.created_by, ser.created_time, ser.updated_by, ser.updated_time from product_category category join product_series ser on category.category_id = ser.category_id where category.category_id = #{categoryId} ORDER BY series_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_series ( category_id, series_name, series_image, series_description, is_spiritpower, is_hot, is_avoid, is_popular_new, is_hot_recommend, price, price_ranges, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{seriesName}, #{seriesImage}, #{seriesDescription}, #{isSpiritPower}, #{isHot}, #{isAvoid}, #{isPopularNew}, #{isHotRecommend}, #{price}, #{priceRanges}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE product_series SET category_id = #{categoryId}, series_name = #{seriesName}, series_image = #{seriesImage}, series_description = #{seriesDescription}, is_spiritpower = #{isSpiritPower}, is_hot = #{isHot}, is_avoid = #{isAvoid}, is_popular_new = #{isPopularNew}, is_hot_recommend = #{isHotRecommend}, price = #{price}, price_ranges = #{priceRanges}, is_on_sale = #{isOnSale}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_time = NOW() WHERE series_id = #{seriesId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_seriesid AS seriesId, COUNT(bp.product_id) AS purchaseCount FROM box_product bp INNER JOIN product p ON bp.product_id = p.product_id WHERE bp.activity_type IN ('一番赏', '踩雷赏') GROUP BY p.product_seriesid
